title: Paul McCartney live: Palau Sant Jordi, Barcelona | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Palau Sant Jordi in Barcelona, Spain, on 29 March 2003.

It was the third date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003, and the second of two consecutive nights in Barcelona.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Palau Sant Jordi on 26 and 27 October 1993 during the New World Tour.
